brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: ONE Japanese basketball article thumbnail, landscape 16:9, 1792 x 1024 or preferably 1920 x 1080 pixels; minimum width 1000 px. Generate a single finished opaque PNG.
Primary request: Create an original hand-drawn ink-and-brush sports editorial illustration for バスケまとめ, matching the approved black/lime reference's visual vocabulary: near-black #151A18, electric lime #CCF43B, warm off-white, orange basketball, strong brushwork, bold readable Japanese typography, few elements. Not photorealistic.

Editorial content source is ONLY the supplied fixed article: November 20, 2026 B.ONE games have started at 19:05 JST but every official game record remains unconfirmed as of 19:05 JST. No final scores or confirmed player performances. The season averages listed in the article are not that day's achievements.
Subject: exactly ONE real athlete, Mark Burton (マーク・バートン), randomly drawn from the ten named players in the article. Use his appearance as seen in the official B.LEAGUE profile photograph viewed in the conversation (https://www.bleague.jp/files/user/roster/750/2026-27/5100000090_03.png). Do not render a generic invented athlete. Likeness details: close-cropped black hair with low fade and neat rounded hairline, medium warm brown skin represented in ink/off-white shading, elongated oval face with defined cheekbones and tapered jaw, dark almond-shaped eyes, gently arched dark eyebrows, medium-width nose, a slim moustache and distinct small pointed chin goatee separated from cheeks; slim athletic guard build; tattoos across shoulders and arms; black compression sleeve on his RIGHT elbow/forearm. Match face shape, short hair, moustache and pointed goatee faithfully. The profile smile may become a focused playing expression, with eyes and mouth shapes recognizable. Do not copy the photograph into the result.
Clothes: completely plain off-white basketball jersey and shorts with black shading, no lettering, number, sponsor marks, league/team logos, or badge shapes. Tattoos can be abstract ink motifs without lettering.
Scene: imagined basketball motion, never a reconstruction of a November 20 game. A dynamic low driving dribble, torso leaning forward, face in a readable near-front three-quarter view, one hand naturally spread over an orange basketball at hip/knee height and the other arm bent to protect the drive. Anatomically credible two arms, two hands, five fingers per hand, plausible joints. Only one ball, as a prop being controlled by the player.
Composition: athlete on the LEFT 44% of canvas, head fully visible, face large enough to recognize; upper body and thighs in frame, with the lower legs intentionally outside frame. Basketball and both hands entirely inside frame. Diagonal lime dry-brush streaks behind athlete. Text on the RIGHT 52%, clear of face, hands, ball and brush splatter. This deliberately varies the reference's right-side shooter layout. No stadium, other people, scoreboard, court markings, extra decorations or panels.
Text (verbatim, no other text and do not put athlete name on image):
small header at upper right: "バスケまとめ"
medium line beneath: "11/20 試合結果"
small tag: "B.ONE"
very large headline on two lines:
"公式記録"
"確定待ち"
The first headline line is warm white, second is vivid lime; extra-bold Japanese gothic, clear correct characters with restrained ink texture.
medium qualifying line directly below headline: "2026.11.20 19:05 JST時点"
fully readable footer near bottom right, at least 28 px tall at 1792 px output: "イラスト（AI生成）"
next to it or on the following line: "イメージ"
All text must be spelled exactly; no name, jersey number, scores, rankings, statistics, performance claims or claims of participation. The large wording 確定待ち is mandatory and cannot be visually minimized.
Keep at least 5% safety margins around all lettering; no clipped glyphs or hands. All lettering horizontal. Premium, energetic editorial ink illustration, not a photo or 3D render. Do not inherit any name, date, point total, game result or team name from the approved reference.

ONE ALLOWED REVISION
Edit image 1, the generated basketball thumbnail. Image 2 is the official B.LEAGUE portrait of the real player Mark Burton; use image 2 ONLY to refine facial likeness and haircut, never paste the photograph and never copy any uniform logo, sponsor, badge or number.
Make this one final correction pass. Preserve the existing black #151A18 / lime #CCF43B / off-white ink-brush illustration, left-hand athlete placement (the athlete's own RIGHT arm has the black sleeve), right-hand typography, orange ball, all exact text, and 16:9 horizontal shape.
Correct the framing: zoom out the illustration and typography slightly within the SAME full black/lime 16:9 canvas, redistribute space gracefully, and extend the brush background as needed. Show the entire orange basketball with a small clear margin below it; both hands, all fingers, head and arm joints must be wholly inside the frame. Torso/thighs may continue naturally off the bottom; do not shrink into a square. Keep every text glyph and footer at least 4% away from the right and bottom image edges. The two-line headline remains the largest element and legible at thumbnail size. Do not clip any glyph.
Refine likeness against image 2: much shorter close-cropped black hair, neat rounded hairline, smooth low fade (NOT a tall or curly top); preserve the official photograph's elongated oval face, gentle eye shape, eyebrow shape, nose, narrow moustache and small pointed chin goatee, with relatively clean cheeks. Match the player identity while keeping the focused dynamic dribble expression and hand-drawn illustrated style. No photorealism.
Keep the anatomically plausible pose and precisely five fingers per hand. No extra people or ball.
All text MUST remain verbatim, with no additions:
バスケまとめ
11/20 試合結果
B.ONE
公式記録
確定待ち
2026.11.20 19:05 JST時点
イラスト（AI生成）
イメージ
This is an imaginary action illustration, not an actual match scene; do not add the player's name, jersey number, stats, final scores or claims of participation.
Output exactly one polished PNG, around 16:9, width above 1000 pixels.
